how.title: How is this worked out?
how.year: Each booking counts in the year of check-in.
how.gross: For each booking we count what the guest paid.
how.payout: For each booking we count what you received, after the Airbnb and Booking.com fees.
how.cancelled: Cancelled bookings count only if you were paid something, and only what you were paid. Requests that are not confirmed do not count.
how.total: Tax is worked out in brackets on the year's total: each slice of income is taxed at its own bracket's rate.
how.perApartment: Tax is worked out in brackets separately for each apartment: each slice of income is taxed at its own bracket's rate.
